item.title: IMPD: High‑Speed Chase Ended in Rollover, Fire
item.description: INDIANAPOLIS – A crash on the west side of Indianapolis followed a police chase. Officers attempted to stop a driver near northbound I-465 and the Crawfordsville Road exit. item.title: Indiana Offers Free Soil Testing for Farmers
item.description: STATEWIDE –A free state program is giving Hoosier farmers more information about what their soil needs — and what it doesn’t. The Indiana State Department of Agriculture is again offering no-cost soil sampling for farmers within the Mississippi River Basin. The goal is to help producers make informed fertilizer decisions, improve yields, and reduce runoff […]
